name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations | HubSpot, Attribution, Lifecycle & Pipeline Systems
summary: Marketing operations builder who doesn't call a campaign finished until the tracking can explain it. I build lifecycle stages, lead scoring, routing, nurture, and reactivation in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, instrument UTMs and conversion events at build time, and run outbound with sequencing and enrichment tools. At Solenzo I built a 20+ workflow lifecycle system and an inbound audit offer that enrolled 180+ businesses. A decade carrying a B2B quota means I build for the sales handoff, not around it.

experience.title: Marketing Operations Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Define lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and qualification criteria, and build routing, nurture, and reactivation of dormant contacts across email and SMS in HubSpot and GoHighLevel.
Instrument every campaign at build time: GA4 conversion events, Meta Pixel, and Google Ads tags through custom GTM triggers, with enforced UTM conventions.
Built an inbound motion around a free audit offer and LinkedIn organic: 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients, with 18 published articles feeding it.
Built segmented outbound engines with personalized, AI-generated outreach, holding email deliverability above 99%.
Build dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, and report results on a regular cadence.
